# World Wide Journals

> > World Wide Journals is a premier open-access academic publishing platform hosting multiple peer-reviewed, multidisciplinary research journals with global indexing and author-friendly submission processes.

World Wide Journals operates a portfolio of double-reviewed, monthly peer-reviewed journals including IJAR, IJSR, GJRA, and PARIPEX. The platform is recognized by major indexing services including Google Scholar and UGC, serving researchers across medical, scientific, engineering, and applied research disciplines with transparent peer-review processes and open submission policies.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed research
- Open-access publishing
- Academic journals

## Flagship Journals

- [World Wide Journals - Home](https://worldwidejournals.com): Open-access publishing platform with multiple peer-reviewed journals for global research dissemination
- [IJAR - Indian Journal of Applied Research](https://worldwidejournals.com/indian-journal-of-applied-research-(IJAR)): Double-reviewed monthly peer-reviewed journal for applied research across multiple disciplines
- [IJSR - International Journal of Scientific Research](https://worldwidejournals.com/international-journal-of-scientific-research-(IJSR)): Double-reviewed monthly peer-reviewed journal specializing in medical and scientific research
- [GJRA - Global Journal For Research Analysis](https://worldwidejournals.com/global-journal-for-research-analysis-GJRA): Double-reviewed monthly multidisciplinary research journal with open submissions for global researchers
- [PARIPEX - Paripex Indian Journal Of Research](https://worldwidejournals.com/paripex): Peer-reviewed journal for unique unpublished research in engineering, science, and applied fields
